initial_control: Zero gates and a deterministic nonzero signed bias per site. The affine bias is the exact native fixed-radius output with zero gates. All arms have the same residual on every input at initialization; verify actual logits on train probes. Not continuously energy matched.
sampling: Disjoint 64-ID windows per chapter, never bridge chapters or add special tokens. Select floor((2i+1)*N/(2k)) for i in [0,k). Select 512 across the complete training pool; select 8 per evaluated chapter. Seeds permute the same 512 training windows by SHA256(seed:index).
case_order: Cycle arm order by seed index; never select by interim results. Freeze all nine final checkpoints before evaluating any scored split.
primary: Final token-weighted unsmoothed NLL on Persuasion: learned4 minus affine, paired by seed. Negative favors learned4. Report all seeds, mean, and chapter-level direction; no promotion or population significance claim.
secondary: each trained arm minus frozen base / frozen matched initial model
repeat on the six previously used development chapters, not a new test set
failure: Stop on first error or nonfinite output; keep partial cases, no automatic retry, alternate arm, training extension or checkpoint selection.
claim_limits: matched training token/update budgets, not exact FLOPs or parameter count
no generation-quality, pretraining-novelty or general FT advantage claim
